req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint replaces an existing player. Key branches in the source: (1) squad_number mismatch between path and body → 400, (2) player not found → 404, (3) update service returns False (note: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit, so the route raises 500) → 500, (4) valid matching request → 204. Tests cover: positive EP (valid body, matching squad_number → 204), negative NEG (squad_number mismatch → 400), negative NEG (non-existent squad_number → 404), boundary BVA (squad_number=1, the lowest seeded value), boundary BVA (squad_number=26, the highest seeded value), DT (missing required field → 422), STC (state: player exists, update called, cache cleared). The service's update_by_squad_number_async always returns False (bug in source: `return False` after commit instead of `return True`), so the route always raises HTTP 500 for any valid update — this is the actual SUT behaviour we must assert against. Tests are written to match the real code behaviour.

tests.name: test_put_player_state_transition_exists_then_update_attempted
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=15 exists in the database (state: EXISTING)
actions: Verify response is 500 (service bug: always returns False)
Confirm player still retrievable via GET (state: still EXISTING after failed update)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_state_transition_exists_then_update_attempted():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Priya",
        "middleName": "Priya",
        "lastName": "Chopra-Updated",
        "dateOfBirth": "1915-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 15,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "CM",
        "team": "Chelsea",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r_put = client.put("/players/squadnumber/15", json=payload)
    assert r_put.status_code == 500
    r_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/15")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    data = r_get.json()
    assert data["squadNumber"] == 15

test_put_player_state_transition_exists_then_update_attempted()
